summary.name: KeePassXC
summary.one_liner: KeePassXC is a free, open source, cross-platform password manager.
use_cases: unlock password database quickly on macOS or Linux
sync password databases with external tools
run password manager on ARM64 Windows or Linux
summary.what_it_does: The page announces the KeePassXC 2.8.0 stable release, the first stable version of the 2.8 series. Major changes listed include migrating from Qt5 to Qt6, Auto-Type on Wayland (Linux), configurable keyboard shortcuts, and remote database synchronization with external tools. It also adds quick unlock with a password on macOS and quick unlock via Polkit on Linux. Version 2.8.0 ships native ARM64 builds for Windows and an experimental AArch64 AppImage for Linux. The page text also notes many bugfixes and several security updates.
notable: Quick unlock via Polkit on Linux and with password on macOS
Native ARM64 builds for Windows and experimental AArch64 AppImage for Linux
Remote database synchronization with external tools
caveats: The Linux AArch64 AppImage is experimental.
The page does not state pricing details beyond the listing's description of it as free.
